select coach_id, tournament_name ,tournament_id, season_id, season, count(1) as num,
sum(case when wdl = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as loss,
sum(case when wdl = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as draw,
sum(case when wdl = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as win
from (
select a.coach_id,b.team_id, a.home_team_id, a.away_team_id,a.tournament_id, a.tournament_name, a.season_id,a.season, a.result,
case
when b.team_id = a.home_team_id then (case
WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(a.result, 1, LOCATE(':',a.result)-1), SIGNED) > CONVERT(SUBSTRING(a.result, LOCATE(':',a.result)+1, CHAR_LENGTH(a.result)), SIGNED) THEN 3
WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(a.result, 1, LOCATE(':',a.result)-1), SIGNED) < CONVERT(SUBSTRING(a.result, LOCATE(':',a.result)+1, CHAR_LENGTH(a.result)), SIGNED) THEN 0
else 1 end )
when b.team_id = a.away_team_id then (case

else 1 end ) end as wdl
from p_coach_match_detail as a

		WHEN wdl = 1 THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS draw
	, sum(CASE
		WHEN wdl = 3 THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS win
FROM (

from (

		,b.biz_2_name as biz_2_name,b.biz_3_name as biz_3_name,b.biz_4_name as biz_4_name,d.deal_nick as deal_nick,d.ad_account as ad_account,d.org_name as dept_name
		,case when d.org_level=7 then org_6_name when d.org_level=6 then org_5_name when d.org_level=5 then org_4_name when d.org_level=4 then org_3_name when d.org_level=3 then org_2_name when d.org_level=2 then org_1_name else '' end as group_name
		,d.company_id as company_id,d.company_type_id as company_type_id,p.biz_type as biz_type 
	from tpp_case_phone p 
		join dim_tb_crm_call_biz b on p.biz_type=b.biz_id 
		join dim_tb_crm_deal d on p.owner=d.deal_id 
	where p.end_time is null  
		and p.owner <> 0 and d.ad_account is not null and (d.org_2_id='109704' 
			or d.org_2_id='111059' or d.org_2_id='110989' or d.org_2_id='110694' or d.org_2_id='110301' or d.org_2_id='110296') 
		and p.gmt_create >= '2018-02-26 13:11:00' and p.gmt_create <= '2018-02-26 13:12:58' ) q  
		where q.case_id in ((select case_id from tpp_action_case where action_code=999990 ) MINUS (select case_id from tpp_action_case where action_code=999997))

SELECT q.case_id AS case_id
FROM (
	SELECT p.id AS case_id, p.gmt_create AS create_time, p.member_id AS member_id, b.biz_2_name AS biz_2_name, b.biz_3_name AS biz_3_name
		, b.biz_4_name AS biz_4_name, d.deal_nick AS deal_nick, d.ad_account AS ad_account, d.org_name AS dept_name
		, CASE
			WHEN d.org_level = 7 THEN org_6_name
			WHEN d.org_level = 6 THEN org_5_name
			WHEN d.org_level = 5 THEN org_4_name
			WHEN d.org_level = 4 THEN org_3_name
			WHEN d.org_level = 3 THEN org_2_name
			WHEN d.org_level = 2 THEN org_1_name
			ELSE ''
		END AS group_name, d.company_id AS company_id, d.company_type_id AS company_type_id, p.biz_type AS biz_type
	FROM tpp_case_phone p
		JOIN dim_tb_crm_call_biz b ON p.biz_type = b.biz_id
		JOIN dim_tb_crm_deal d ON p.owner = d.deal_id
	WHERE p.end_time IS NULL
		AND p.owner <> 0

			OR d.org_2_id = '110694'
			OR d.org_2_id = '110301'
			OR d.org_2_id = '110296')
		AND p.gmt_create >= '2018-02-26 13:11:00'
		AND p.gmt_create <= '2018-02-26 13:12:58'
) q
WHERE q.case_id IN (
	SELECT case_id

WITH x AS (
        SELECT o.open_id AS open_id
        FROM purchases_order o
        WHERE DATE(o.order_start_date) >= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
            AND DATE(o.order_start_date) <= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
            AND o.order_status <= 10
        ORDER BY 1
    ),
    c AS (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders
        FROM x
        GROUP BY x.open_id
        ORDER BY 1
    ),
    y AS (
        SELECT SUM(c.orders) AS total
        FROM c
        ORDER BY 1
    ),
    z AS (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS single
        FROM x
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM purchases_order o, c
            WHERE c.orders <= 1
                AND o.open_id = x.open_id
                AND DATE(o.order_start_date) < IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
            ORDER BY 1
        )
        ORDER BY 1
    )
SELECT ROUND((y.total - z.single) / y.total, 2) AS value
FROM y, z
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND((y.total - z.single) / y.total, 2) AS value
FROM (
	SELECT SUM(c.orders) AS total
	FROM (
		SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders
		FROM (
			SELECT o.open_id AS open_id
			FROM purchases_order o
			WHERE DATE(o.order_start_date) >= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
				AND DATE(o.order_start_date) <= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
				AND o.order_status <= 10
			ORDER BY 1
		) x
		GROUP BY x.open_id
		ORDER BY 1
	) c
	ORDER BY 1
) y, (
		SELECT COUNT(*) AS single
		FROM (
			SELECT o.open_id AS open_id
			FROM purchases_order o
			WHERE DATE(o.order_start_date) >= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
				AND DATE(o.order_start_date) <= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
				AND o.order_status <= 10
			ORDER BY 1
		) x
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM purchases_order o, (
					SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders
					FROM (
						SELECT o.open_id AS open_id
						FROM purchases_order o
						WHERE DATE(o.order_start_date) >= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
							AND DATE(o.order_start_date) <= IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
							AND o.order_status <= 10
						ORDER BY 1
					) x
					GROUP BY x.open_id
					ORDER BY 1
				) c
			WHERE c.orders <= 1
				AND o.open_id = x.open_id
				AND DATE(o.order_start_date) < IFNULL(NULL, current_date())
			ORDER BY 1
		)
		ORDER BY 1
	) z
ORDER BY 1

SELECT houseInfo.id, contract.code, actualReceiMoney.actual_received_date, org.name AS orgName, org.id AS orgId

	, IFNULL(mdmwbsitem.sales_name, mdmwbsitem.name) AS 楼栋名称
	, ifnull(hitem.mdm_full_name, '') AS 主数据房间长名称, houseInfo.sales_name AS full_name
	, houseType.house_type_name AS 户型名称, houseType.house_type_form AS 户型结构, pi.name AS 装修标准
	, (CASE
		WHEN contract.online_contract_status = '网签' THEN CONCAT('已网签-', contract.online_contract_no)
		ELSE '未网签'
	END) AS 合同备案号, contract.code AS 合同编号, orderinfo.sign_date AS order_date
	, str_to_date(orderinfo.vesting_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 认购归属时间
	, str_to_date(contract.sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 签约时间
	, str_to_date(contract.vesting_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 签约归属时间
	, str_to_date(contract.approve_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 审核时间
	, (CASE
		WHEN houseInfo.actual_inner_area IS NULL
			OR houseInfo.actual_inner_area = 0
		THEN ifnull(houseInfo.forecast_inner_area, 0)
		ELSE houseInfo.actual_inner_area
	END) AS 合同套内面积
	, (CASE
		WHEN houseInfo.actual_floor_area IS NULL
			OR houseInfo.actual_floor_area = 0
		THEN ifnull(houseInfo.forecast_floor_area, 0)
		ELSE houseInfo.actual_floor_area
	END) AS 合同建筑面积
	, IF(tran.decoration_moneymanage = 0, IFNULL(tran.deal_price, 0), IFNULL(tran.deal_price, 0) + IFNULL(tran.decoration_amount, 0)) AS 合同金额
	, actualReceiMoney.totalMoney, actualReceiMoney.totalMoney1 AS 审核回款金额, actualReceiMoney.totalMoney AS 回款金额
	, ROUND(actualReceiMoney.totalMoney / IF(tran.decoration_moneymanage = 0, IFNULL(tran.deal_price, 0), IFNULL(tran.deal_price, 0) + IFNULL(tran.decoration_amount, 0)) * 100, 2) AS 回款比例
	, IFNULL(tran.deal_price, 0) AS 毛坯合同金额
	, ssdj + sssq + sslk + sssy + ssgjj + sslybzj + sszj AS 毛坯回款金额
	, ROUND((ssdj + sssq + sslk + sssy + ssgjj + +sslybzj + sszj) / deal_price * 100, 2) AS 毛坯回款比例
	, IFNULL(tran.decoration_amount, 0) AS 装修合同金额
	, sszx + sszxfy + sszxk + ss_sjzxf + ss_sjgzzxf AS 装修回款金额
	, ROUND((sszx + sszxfy + sszxk + ss_sjzxf + ss_sjgzzxf) / decoration_amount * 100, 2) AS 装修回款比例
	, str_to_date(act1_date.actual_received_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 最后回款时间

		WHEN tran.decoration_merge_flag = 1
			AND decoration_moneymanage = 1

		WHEN tran.decoration_merge_flag = 1
			AND decoration_moneymanage = 0
		THEN (tran.deal_price - decoration_amount) / tran.sta_price
		WHEN tran.decoration_merge_flag = 0 THEN tran.deal_price / tran.sta_price
	END) * 100, 2) AS 最终折扣
	, payment.name AS 付款方式, sdd_item.NAME AS 付款方式类型, depayment.name AS 装修付款方式, paymentplan.ysdj AS 应收定金, actualReceiMoney.ssdj AS 实收定金

	, actualReceiMoney.ssaj AS 实收按揭, paymentplan.ysbc AS 应收面积差款, actualReceiMoney.ssbc AS 实收面积差款, paymentplan.ysdsfy AS 应收代收费用, actualReceiMoney.ssdsfy AS 实收代收费用

	, str_to_date(contract.sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 草签日期
	, str_to_date(orderinfo.expect_sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 预计签约日期
	, (CASE
		WHEN orderinfo.expect_sign_date IS NOT NULL
			AND orderinfo.expect_sign_date > contract.vesting_date
		THEN '不逾期'
		ELSE '逾期'
	END) AS 是否逾期, contract.appointed_deliver_date AS '交付日期', paymentplan.whkAmount AS '未回款金额'
	, IFNULL(ui.sale_unit_name, ui.unit_no) AS 单元名称
	, IFNULL(fi.sales_floor_name, fi.floor_no) AS 楼层, sitem.`name` AS '客户属性'
	, tran.expire_date AS '税单到期日'
FROM midea_sd_contract_info contract
	LEFT JOIN midea_sd_order_contract_transaction tran ON contract.transaction_id = tran.id
	LEFT JOIN midea_sd_sddict_item sitem ON tran.purchase_nature = sitem.code
	LEFT JOIN midea_sd_transaction_customer customerNameItem ON tran.id = customerNameItem.transaction_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		/*/*最开始交易的那匹客户,会出现同时插入的多个联名客户的情况,要进行选择 */
		SELECT transaction_source.*
		FROM (
			SELECT tin.transaction_id, min(tin.transaction_source_px) AS transaction_source_px_min
			FROM (
				SELECT tc.transaction_id/*/*交易id */
					, tc.sort
					, CASE
						WHEN tc.transaction_source LIKE '%智美分销%' THEN 1
						WHEN tc.transaction_source LIKE '%智美置家%' THEN 2
						WHEN IFNULL(tc.transaction_source, '') NOT LIKE '%智美分销%'
							AND IFNULL(tc.transaction_source, '') NOT LIKE '%智美置家%'
							AND tc.sort = '1'
						THEN 3
					END AS transaction_source_px, DATE_FORMAT(tc.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_date
				FROM  /*/*创建日期 */
				midea_sd_transaction_customer tc
					LEFT JOIN (
						/* /*粒度区分到分钟(只可能有一条,也肯定有一条) */
						SELECT tc1.id, tc1.transaction_id
							, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(tc1.create_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_date
						FROM midea_sd_transaction_customer tc1
						GROUP BY tc1.transaction_id
					) bestCreatDate
					ON bestCreatDate.transaction_id = tc.transaction_id
						AND bestCreatDate.create_date = DATE_FORMAT(tc.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')
				WHERE bestCreatDate.id IS NOT NULL
			) tin
			WHERE transaction_source_px IS NOT NULL
			GROUP BY transaction_id
		) transaction_source_min
			LEFT JOIN (
				/* /*最开始交易的那匹客户,会出现同时插入的多个联名客户的情况,要进行选择 */
				SELECT DISTINCT tin.transaction_id, tin.transaction_source AS sourceChannel, tin.transaction_source_px
				FROM (
					SELECT tc.id/*/*交易客户表id */
						, tc.transaction_id/*/*交易id*/
						, tc.customer_name/*/*客户名字 */
						, tc.sort/*/*排序 */
						, tc.transaction_source/*/*来访渠道 */
						
						, tc.sales_org_id, tc.potential_customer_id, tc.customer_source_id, tc.mobile_phone, tc.certificate_type
						, tc.certificate_no, tc.address, tc.postal_code
						, CASE
							WHEN tc.transaction_source LIKE '%智美分销%' THEN 1
							WHEN tc.transaction_source LIKE '%智美置家%' THEN 2
							WHEN IFNULL(tc.transaction_source, '') NOT LIKE '%智美分销%'
								AND IFNULL(tc.transaction_source, '') NOT LIKE '%智美置家%'
								AND tc.sort = '1'
							THEN 3
						END AS transaction_source_px, DATE_FORMAT(tc.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_date
					FROM  /*/*创建日期 */
					midea_sd_transaction_customer tc
						LEFT JOIN (
							/*/*粒度区分到分钟(只可能有一条,也肯定有一条)*/
							SELECT tc1.id, tc1.transaction_id
								, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(tc1.create_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_date
							FROM midea_sd_transaction_customer tc1

select date(created_at)创建日期,
count(distinct task_id)整体维修创建量,
count(distinct case when order_type='客户预约'then task_id end)预约报修创建量,
count(distinct case when order_type='客户预约'then task_id end)/count(distinct task_id)预约维修创建比例,
count(distinct case when hour(created_at)>=9 and hour(created_at)<21 and order_type='客户预约'then task_id end)预约维修工作时间创建量,
count(case when hour(created_at)>=9 and hour(created_at)<21 and timestampdiff(MINUTE,created_at,assign_at)<=30 then task_id end)预约维修工作时间及时受理量,
count(case when hour(created_at)>=9 and hour(created_at)<21 and timestampdiff(MINUTE,created_at,assign_at)<=30 then task_id end)/count(distinct case when hour(created_at)>=9 and hour(created_at)<21 and order_type='客户预约'then task_id end)30分钟受理率（工作时间）
from basic_repair_tasks
where date(created_at)>='2019-03-01'
and date(created_at)<=date_sub(curdate(),interval 1 day)
group by date(created_at)

SELECT date(created_at) AS 创建日期, count(DISTINCT task_id) AS 整体维修创建量
	, count(DISTINCT CASE
		WHEN order_type = '客户预约' THEN task_id
	END) AS 预约报修创建量
	, count(DISTINCT CASE
		WHEN order_type = '客户预约' THEN task_id
	END) / count(DISTINCT task_id) AS 预约维修创建比例
	, count(DISTINCT CASE
		WHEN hour(created_at) >= 9
			AND hour(created_at) < 21
			AND order_type = '客户预约'
		THEN task_id
	END) AS 预约维修工作时间创建量
	, count(CASE
		WHEN hour(created_at) >= 9
			AND hour(created_at) < 21
			AND timestampdiff(MINUTE, created_at, assign_at) <= 30
		THEN task_id
	END) AS 预约维修工作时间及时受理量
	, count(CASE
		WHEN hour(created_at) >= 9
			AND hour(created_at) < 21
			AND timestampdiff(MINUTE, created_at, assign_at) <= 30
		THEN task_id
	END) / count(DISTINCT CASE
		WHEN hour(created_at) >= 9
			AND hour(created_at) < 21
			AND order_type = '客户预约'
		THEN task_id
	END) AS 30分钟受理率（工作时间）
FROM basic_repair_tasks
WHERE date(created_at) >= '2019-03-01'
	AND date(created_at) <= date_sub(curdate(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY date(created_at)

select a.cat_id1,a.cat_name1,a.cat_id2,a.cat_name2,a.cat_id3,a.cat_name3,a.leaf_cat_id,a.leaf_cat_name,
       concat(case when cat_name1 is not null then concat(cat_name1,'>>') else '' end,
              case when cat_name2 is not null then concat(cat_name2,'>>') else '' end,
              case when cat_name3 is not null then concat(cat_name3,'>>') else '' end,
              case when leaf_cat_name is not null then concat(leaf_cat_name) else '' end) as full_name_path
-- select count(1)
from 
(SELECT c1.cat_id as cat_id1,c1.cat_name as cat_name1,c2.cat_id as cat_id2,c2.cat_name as cat_name2,c3.cat_id as cat_id3,c3.cat_name as cat_name3,s.cat_id as leaf_cat_id,s.cat_name as leaf_cat_name
  FROM union_std_categories s
       left join union_std_categories c3
                 left join union_std_categories c2
                           left join union_std_categories c1 on c2.parent_id = c1.cat_id
         on c3.parent_id = c2.cat_id
       on s.parent_id = c3.cat_id
 where s.channel_id=24 and s.deleted = 0 and s.is_leaf = 1
 and s.cat_id in (127234002 )
) a

SELECT a.cat_id1, a.cat_name1, a.cat_id2, a.cat_name2, a.cat_id3
	, a.cat_name3, a.leaf_cat_id, a.leaf_cat_name
	, concat(CASE
		WHEN cat_name1 IS NOT NULL THEN concat(cat_name1, '>>')
		ELSE ''
	END, CASE
		WHEN cat_name2 IS NOT NULL THEN concat(cat_name2, '>>')
		ELSE ''
	END, CASE
		WHEN cat_name3 IS NOT NULL THEN concat(cat_name3, '>>')
		ELSE ''
	END, CASE
		WHEN leaf_cat_name IS NOT NULL THEN concat(leaf_cat_name)
		ELSE ''
	END) AS full_name_path -- select count(1)
FROM (
	SELECT c1.cat_id AS cat_id1, c1.cat_name AS cat_name1, c2.cat_id AS cat_id2, c2.cat_name AS cat_name2, c3.cat_id AS cat_id3
		, c3.cat_name AS cat_name3, s.cat_id AS leaf_cat_id, s.cat_name AS leaf_cat_name
	FROM union_std_categories s
		LEFT JOIN union_std_categories c3
		LEFT JOIN union_std_categories c2
		LEFT JOIN union_std_categories c1
		ON c2.parent_id = c1.cat_id
			AND c3.parent_id = c2.cat_id
			AND s.parent_id = c3.cat_id
	WHERE s.channel_id = 24
		AND s.deleted = 0
		AND s.is_leaf = 1
		AND s.cat_id IN (127234002)
) a

		, CASE

(SELECT 'ios', d.server_id, idfa, app_version
	, COALESCE(last_channel, channel) AS channel, city_id
	, province_id, country_id, '' AS device_brand, device_model, resolution
	, CASE
		WHEN is_app_new = 2 THEN 'new'
		ELSE 'active'
	END AS user_type
FROM (
	SELECT server_id, idfa, app_version, city_id, province_id
		, country_id, device_model, resolution, is_app_new
	FROM (
		SELECT t.server_id, idfa, max(app_version) OVER (PARTITION BY t.server_id ) AS app_version
			, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.server_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS row_num, city_id, province_id
			, country_id, device_model, resolution
			, CASE
				WHEN t1.server_id IS NOT NULL THEN 2
				ELSE 1
			END AS is_app_new
		FROM (
			SELECT *
			FROM hive.oa1878750739446285_bigdataop_parquet.stat_sdk_ios
			WHERE date_p = '20181201'
				AND app_key_p = 'BDFAFB4ACC7885EE'
				AND app_version IS NOT NULL
				AND event_id = 'app_start'
				AND app_version NOT REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]'
		) t
			LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT server_id, date_p
				FROM hive.oa1878750739446285_stat_sdk_parquet.sdk_odz_new_device_info
				WHERE date_p = 20181201
					AND os_p = 'ios'
					AND app_key_p = 'BDFAFB4ACC7885EE'
			) t1
			ON t.server_id = t1.server_id
	) t
	WHERE row_num = 1
) d
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT server_id
			, if(channel IS NULL
				OR regexp_replace(channel, ' ', '') = '', 'unknown', lower(regexp_replace(channel, ' ', ''))) AS channel
		FROM (
			SELECT server_id, channel, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS row_num
			FROM hive.oa1878750739446285_bigdataop_parquet.sdk_channel_data
			WHERE type_p = 'ios'
				AND app_key = 'BDFAFB4ACC7885EE'
				AND channel IS NOT NULL
		) t
		WHERE row_num = 1
	) tt
	ON d.server_id = tt.server_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT server_id, last_channel
		FROM (
			SELECT server_id
				, if(channel IS NULL
					OR regexp_replace(channel, ' ', '') = '', 'unknown', lower(regexp_replace(channel, ' ', ''))) AS last_channel
				, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY receive_time DESC) AS row_num

SELECT supplier AS 'supplier', offline_num AS 'offlineCount', online_num AS 'onlineCount', current_all_num AS 'currentAllCount'
	, (
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS all_num
		FROM cnt_iot_device
		WHERE status IN (1, 0)
			AND tenant = 'cainiao'
			AND supplier != 'TS'
			AND supplier IN ('DC', 'HS', 'ZL')
	) AS 'allDeviceCount'
FROM (
	SELECT t_offline.supplier AS 'supplier', t_offline.offline_num AS 'offline_num', t_online.online_num AS 'online_num', t_offline.offline_num + t_online.online_num AS 'current_all_num'
	FROM (
		SELECT supplier, COUNT(1) AS offline_num
		FROM cnt_iot_device
		WHERE status IN (1)
			AND tenant = 'cainiao'
			AND supplier != 'TS'
			AND supplier IN ('DC', 'HS', 'ZL')
		GROUP BY supplier
		ORDER BY 1, 2
	) t_offline
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT supplier, online_num
			FROM (
				SELECT supplier, COUNT(1) AS online_num
				FROM cnt_iot_device
				WHERE status IN (0)
					AND tenant = 'cainiao'
					AND supplier != 'TS'
					AND supplier IN ('DC', 'HS', 'ZL')
				GROUP BY supplier
				ORDER BY 1, 2
			)
			ORDER BY 1, 2
		) t_online
		ON t_offline.supplier = t_online.supplier
	ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) t1
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5;

CREATE TABLE `dc_job_instance` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` varchar(45) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cluster_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `engine_inst_code` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `dependent_code` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '依赖上一个实例code',
  `concurrent_rely` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '并发依赖',
  `job_text` longtext,
  `project_code` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目code',
  `job_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'job名称',
  `job_code` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_type` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(45) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'test' COMMENT '开发实例：dev\n调度实例：schedule\n测试实例：test\n补数据实例：supplement',
  `version` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1：等待运行，3：等待资源，5：运行中，7：运行失败，9：运行成功， 11：暂停， 13：终止',
  `schedule_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '调度开始时间',
  `run_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运行开始时间',
  `run_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运行结束时间',
  `owner` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `bizdate` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务日期：yyyy-MM-dd\n',
  `rundate` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运行日期：yyyy-MM-dd',
  `run_mode` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运行模式：jobserver, thriftserver, phoenix、tidb',
  `runtimes` int(16) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '运行时间，单位秒',
  `res_cu` decimal(20,5) DEFAULT '0.00000' COMMENT '计算消耗资源，单位cu',
  `retry_count` int(11) DEFAULT '0',
  `failure_count` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '失败次数',
  `last_notify_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最新一次告警通知时间',
  `alarm_count` int(11) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '告警次数',
  `error_type` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '系统异常：sys\n作业异常：job',
  `spark_application_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT 'spark app id',
  `spark_group_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Spark group id',
  `spark_web_url` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gmt_created` datetime NOT NULL,
  `gmt_modified` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `creater` varchar(45) NOT NULL,
  `modifier` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code_UNIQUE` (`code`),
  KEY `project_code_index` (`project_code`),
  KEY `job_code_index` (`job_code`),
  KEY `type_index` (`type`),
  KEY `spark_app_id_index` (`spark_application_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_job_text` (`job_text`,`spark_application_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=23185 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 ROW_FORMAT=COMPACT;

select
    cbm_name as cbm_name,
    team_name as team,
    month_earn as month_gaap,
    month_kpi as month_kpi,
    month_kpi - month_earn as month_gaap_gap,
    case when month_kpi =#{month_kpi} then 0 else  month_earn * 100 / month_kpi end as month_complete_rate,
    year_earn as year_gaap,
    year_kpi as year_kpi,
    year_kpi - year_earn as year_gaap_gap,
    case when year_kpi=0 then 0 else year_earn * 100 / year_kpi end as year_complete_rate,
    next_month_kpi as next_month_kpi,
    pipeline as pipeline,
    case when next_month_kpi=0 then 0 else pipeline * 100 / next_month_kpi end as next_month_forecast_rate,
    gaap_cunliang as gaap_cunliang,
    cid_cnt as cid_cnt
from
    (select
        cbm_id,
        cbm_name,
        team_path,
        team_name,
        sum(month_earn) as month_earn,
        sum(year_earn) as year_earn,
        sum(gaap_cunliang) as gaap_cunliang,
        sum(pipeline) as pipeline,
        sum(month_kpi) as month_kpi,
        sum(next_month_kpi) as next_month_kpi,
        sum(year_kpi) as year_kpi
    from
        (select
            cbm_id,
            cbm_name,
            team_path,
            team_name,
            sum(gaap_d_m) as month_earn,
            sum(gaap_fy) as year_earn,
            sum(reserve_gaap_m) as gaap_cunliang,
            sum(ppl_fcst) as pipeline,
            0 as month_kpi,
            0 as next_month_kpi,
            0 as year_kpi
        from dwd_aly_sop_gaap_di
        where stat_date = #{thedate} and 
     case when #{sys_is_cbm}='true' then   cbm_id = #{sys_emp_id} else 
            team_path like concat(#{sys_team_path}, '%') end 
        group by cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
        union all
        select
            assess_id as cbm_id,
            assess_name as cbm_name,
            team_path,
            team_name,
            0 as month_earn,
            0 as year_earn,
            0 as gaap_cunliang,
            0 as pipeline,
            sum(case when kpi_month = cast(#{thismonth} as bigint) then target_amount else 0 end) as month_kpi,
            sum(case when kpi_month = cast(#{nextmonth} as bigint) then target_amount else 0 end) as next_month_kpi,
            sum(case when kpi_month = cast(#{fiscalyear} as bigint) then target_amount else 0 end) as year_kpi
        from dim_aly_sales_kpi
        where (kpi_month = cast(#{thismonth} as bigint) or kpi_month = cast(#{nextmonth} as bigint) or
            fiscal_year = cast(#{fiscalyear} as bigint))  and assess_type = 1
             and target_type = 1 and 
     case when #{sys_is_cbm}='true' then assess_id = #{sys_emp_id} else 
            team_path like concat(#{sys_team_path}, '%') end 

        group by assess_id, assess_name, team_path, team_name
        ) ti_1
    group by cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
    ) t_1
left outer join
    (select
        cbm_id,
        team_path,
        count(distinct cid_id) as cid_cnt
    from rpt_aly_sop_cust_info_d
    where stat_date = #{thedate} and case when #{sys_is_cbm}='true' then   cbm_id = #{sys_emp_id} else 
            team_path like concat(#{sys_team_path}, '%') end 
    group by cbm_id, team_path
    ) t_2
on t_1.cbm_id = t_2.cbm_id and t_1.team_path = t_2.team_path

SELECT cbm_name AS cbm_name, team_name AS team, month_earn AS month_gaap, month_kpi AS month_kpi
	, month_kpi - month_earn AS month_gaap_gap
	, CASE
		WHEN month_kpi = 1 THEN 0
		ELSE month_earn * 100 / month_kpi
	END AS month_complete_rate, year_earn AS year_gaap, year_kpi AS year_kpi, year_kpi - year_earn AS year_gaap_gap
	, CASE
		WHEN year_kpi = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE year_earn * 100 / year_kpi
	END AS year_complete_rate, next_month_kpi AS next_month_kpi, pipeline AS pipeline
	, CASE
		WHEN next_month_kpi = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE pipeline * 100 / next_month_kpi
	END AS next_month_forecast_rate, gaap_cunliang AS gaap_cunliang, cid_cnt AS cid_cnt
FROM (
	SELECT cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
		, sum(month_earn) AS month_earn, sum(year_earn) AS year_earn
		, sum(gaap_cunliang) AS gaap_cunliang, sum(pipeline) AS pipeline
		, sum(month_kpi) AS month_kpi, sum(next_month_kpi) AS next_month_kpi
		, sum(year_kpi) AS year_kpi
	FROM (
		SELECT cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
			, sum(gaap_d_m) AS month_earn, sum(gaap_fy) AS year_earn
			, sum(reserve_gaap_m) AS gaap_cunliang, sum(ppl_fcst) AS pipeline
			, 0 AS month_kpi, 0 AS next_month_kpi, 0 AS year_kpi
		FROM dwd_aly_sop_gaap_di
		WHERE stat_date = '20181115'
			AND CASE
				WHEN 'true' = 'true' THEN cbm_id = 80882
				ELSE team_path LIKE concat('0.7940.227.7936.', '%')
			END
		GROUP BY cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
		UNION ALL
		SELECT assess_id AS cbm_id, assess_name AS cbm_name, team_path, team_name, 0 AS month_earn
			, 0 AS year_earn, 0 AS gaap_cunliang, 0 AS pipeline
			, sum(CASE
				WHEN kpi_month = CAST('201811' AS bigint) THEN target_amount
				ELSE 0
			END) AS month_kpi
			, sum(CASE
				WHEN kpi_month = CAST('201812' AS bigint) THEN target_amount
				ELSE 0
			END) AS next_month_kpi
			, sum(CASE
				WHEN kpi_month = CAST('2019' AS bigint) THEN target_amount
				ELSE 0
			END) AS year_kpi
		FROM dim_aly_sales_kpi
		WHERE (kpi_month = CAST('201811' AS bigint)
				OR kpi_month = CAST('201812' AS bigint)
				OR fiscal_year = CAST('2019' AS bigint))
			AND assess_type = 1
			AND target_type = 1
			AND CASE
				WHEN 'true' = 'true' THEN assess_id = 80882
				ELSE team_path LIKE concat('0.7940.227.7936.', '%')
			END
		GROUP BY assess_id, assess_name, team_path, team_name
	) ti_1
	GROUP BY cbm_id, cbm_name, team_path, team_name
) t_1
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT cbm_id, team_path, count(DISTINCT cid_id) AS cid_cnt
		FROM rpt_aly_sop_cust_info_d
		WHERE stat_date = '20181115'
			AND CASE
				WHEN 'true' = 'true' THEN cbm_id = 80882
				ELSE team_path LIKE concat('0.7940.227.7936.', '%')
			END
		GROUP BY cbm_id, team_path
	) t_2
	ON t_1.cbm_id = t_2.cbm_id
		AND t_1.team_path = t_2.team_path

SELECT datetrunc(a.gmv_time,'mm') as report_month
,'' GMV
    ,sum(total_amount*0.01) as 支付gmv 
    ,sum(buyer_discount_amount*0.01) as 买家优惠金额
    ,sum(buyer_discount_amount*0.01)/nullif(sum(total_amount*0.01),0) as 优惠占比 
    ------支付gmv-----
    ,sum(a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01) 支付gmv不含优惠
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null  then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01 end) 支付gmv不含优惠_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01 end) 支付gmv不含优惠_老用户
        ----未交付
    ,sum(case when sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv不含优惠
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv不含优惠_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv不含优惠_老用户
    ----交付
    ,sum(case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01end) as 交付gmv不含优惠
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01end) as 交付gmv不含优惠_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null  and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.total_price*0.01 + buyer_freight_amount*0.01 - buyer_discount_amount*0.01end) as 交付gmv不含优惠_老用户
    ----未交付
    ,sum(case when sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 未交付gmv_老用户
    ----交付
    ,sum(case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 交付gmv
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 交付gmv_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then total_amount*0.01 end) as 交付gmv_老用户
,'' 订单量
    ,count(distinct a.sub_order_no) as 支付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null then a.sub_order_no end) as 支付订单量_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.sub_order_no end) as 支付订单量_老用户

    ,count(distinct case when sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 未交付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 未交付订单量_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc <> '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 未交付订单量_老用户

    ,count(distinct case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 交付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 交付订单量_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end) as 交付订单量_老用户
,'' 价单价
    ,sum(total_amount*0.01)/nullif(count(distinct a.sub_order_no),0) as 支付件单价
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null then total_amount*0.01 end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null then a.sub_order_no end),0) as 支付件单价_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null then total_amount*0.01 end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.sub_order_no end),0) as 支付件单价_老用户
,'' 下单人数
    ,count(distinct a.buyer_user_id) as 支付下单人数
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null then a.buyer_user_id end) as 支付下单人数_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.buyer_user_id end) as 支付下单人数_老用户

    ,count(distinct case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.buyer_user_id end) as 交付下单人数
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null  and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.buyer_user_id end) as 交付下单人数_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.buyer_user_id end) as 交付下单人数_老用户

    ,count(distinct a.sub_order_no)/nullif(count(distinct a.buyer_user_id),0) as 支付下单频次
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null then a.sub_order_no end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as 支付下单频次_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.sub_order_no end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as 支付下单频次_老用户

    ,count(distinct case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end)/nullif(count(distinct case when sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as 交付下单频次
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null  and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null  and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功'then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as 交付下单频次_新用户
    ,count(distinct case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.sub_order_no end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is null and sub_order_status_desc = '交易成功' then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as 交付下单频次_老用户

    ,sum(total_amount*0.01)/nullif(count(distinct a.buyer_user_id),0) as ARPU
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is not null then total_amount*0.01 end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is not null  then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as ARPU_新用户
    ,sum(case when c.user_id is null then total_amount*0.01 end)/nullif(count(distinct case when c.user_id is null then a.buyer_user_id end),0) as ARPU_老用户
    
    ,count(distinct a.seller_user_id) as 当月卖家人数
    ,count(distinct case when b.卖家订单量 > 50 then a.seller_user_id end) as 订单量每月50单以上卖家数
    ,count(distinct case when b.卖家订单量 >= 11 and b.卖家订单量 <= 50 then a.seller_user_id end) as 订单量每月11_5卖家数
    ,count(distinct case when b.卖家订单量 >= 6 and b.卖家订单量 <= 10 then a.seller_user_id end) as 订单量每月6_10卖家数
    ,count(distinct case when b.卖家订单量 >= 1 and b.卖家订单量 <= 5 then a.seller_user_id end) as 订单量每月1_5卖家数
    ,count(distinct case when b.卖家订单量 >= 1 and b.卖家订单量 <= 5 then a.seller_user_id end)/count(distinct a.seller_user_id) as 月1_5卖家数占比

    ,count(distinct case when category_lv3_name = '篮球鞋' then a.sub_order_no end) as 篮球鞋支付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when category_lv3_name = '跑步鞋' then a.sub_order_no end) as 跑步鞋支付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when category_lv2_name = '休闲鞋' then a.sub_order_no end) as 休闲鞋支付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when category_lv1_name = '服装' then a.sub_order_no end) as 服装支付订单量
    ,count(distinct case when category_lv1_name <> '服装' and category_lv2_name not in ('休闲鞋') and category_lv3_name not in ('篮球鞋','跑步鞋') then a.sub_order_no end) as 其他支付订单量

    ,count(case when category_lv3_name = '篮球鞋' then sku_id end) as 篮球鞋sku数量
    ,count(case when category_lv3_name = '跑步鞋' then sku_id end) as 跑步鞋sku数量
    ,count(case when category_lv2_name = '休闲鞋' then sku_id end) as 休闲鞋sku数量
    ,count(case when category_lv1_name = '服装' then sku_id end) as 服装支付sku数量
    ,count(case when category_lv1_name <> '服装' and category_lv2_name not in ('休闲鞋') and category_lv3_name not in ('篮球鞋','跑步鞋') then sku_id end) as 其他支付sku数量

	, COUNT(ta.is_open_order) AS open_order_cnt
	, COUNT(t1.is_normal_order) AS normal_order_cnt
	, SUM(t2.is_master_appointed) AS master_appointed_cnt
	, SUM(t1.is_psaz_order) AS psaz_order_cnt
	, SUM(t1.is_az_order) AS az_order_cnt
	, SUM(t1.is_wx_order) AS wx_order_cnt
	, SUM(t1.is_qx_order) AS qx_order_cnt
	, SUM(t2.is_trade_complete) AS trade_complete_cnt
	, SUM(IF(t2.is_trade_complete = 1, t2.order_price, 0)) AS order_income
	, SUM(t2.is_trade_close) AS trade_close_cnt
FROM (
	SELECT order_id
		, member_id
		, order_price
		, region_id
		, appoint_method
		, category
		, serve_types
		, to_char(from_unixtime(add_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS add_date
		, IF(t1.appoint_method = 'open', 1, NULL) AS is_open_order
		, IF(t1.appoint_method = 'normal', 1, NULL) AS is_normal_order
		, IF((t1.category = 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 3)
		OR (t1.category > 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 2), 1, NULL) AS is_psaz_order
		, IF((t1.category = 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 4)
		OR (t1.category > 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 3), 1, NULL) AS is_az_order
		, IF((t1.category = 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 5)
		OR (t1.category > 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 4), 1, NULL) AS is_wx_order
		, IF(t1.category > 1
		AND t1.serve_types = 5, 1, NULL) AS is_qx_order
	FROM bds_order_base_d
	WHERE dt = '${date_minus_1}'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "OA"."HET_MANAGER1_FW" ("LX", "HS") AS 
  SELECT B.SELECTNAME LX,
       AVG(FUN_CAL_TIME_BETWEEN@LINK_OMSS(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RECEIVEDATE ||
                                                          A.RECEIVETIME,
                                                          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
                                                  'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),
                                          TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.OPERATEDATE ||
                                                          D.OPERATETIME,
                                                          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
                                                  'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))) HS
  FROM WORKFLOW_CURRENTOPERATOR A,
       WORKFLOW_SELECTITEM      B,
       FORMTABLE_MAIN_93        C,
       WORKFLOW_CURRENTOPERATOR D
 WHERE A.WORKFLOWID = 606
   AND D.WORKFLOWID = 606
   AND A.NODEID = 2249
   AND D.NODEID = 2251
   AND B.FIELDID = 10259
   AND A.REQUESTID = C.REQUESTID
   AND D.REQUESTID = C.REQUESTID
   AND C.Hetonglx = B.SELECTVALUE
   AND C.SHENQINGRIQI >= '2017-10-01'
   AND C.SHENQINGRIQI <= '2017-12-31'
 GROUP BY B.SELECTNAME

       DECODE(locked_mode,

              5, 'LOCK SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE',
              6, 'ALTER TABLE/DROP TABLE/DROP INDEX/TRUNCATE TABLE/LOCK EXCLUSIVE') sql_actions,

              4, 'S - SHARE', 5, 'SSX - SHARE/SUB EXCLUSIVE', 6, 'X - EXCLUSIVE') Lock_mode

 WHERE DO.object_id = lo.object_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "APPS"."PMI_REP_SALES_DETAILS_V" (
	"ITEM_ID", "ORDER_QUANTITY", "WAREHOUSE_SHIPPED_FROM", "EXTENDED_PRICE_BASE_CURRENCY", "CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY", "SALES_COMPANY", "SALES_ORGANIZATION", "PERIOD_START_DATE", "OPERATING_UNIT_ID", "YEAR_ID", "QUARTER_ID", "PERIOD_ID"
) AS 
SELECT ITEM_ID ,SUM(ORDER_QUANTITY) ORDER_QUANTITY ,WAREHOUSE_SHIPPED_FROM ,SUM(EXTENDED_PRICE_BASE_CURRENCY) EXTENDED_PRICE_BASE_CURRENCY 
	,SUM(CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY) CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY 
	,SALES_COMPANY ,SALES_ORGANIZATION ,PERIOD_START_DATE ,OPERATING_UNIT_ID ,YEAR_ID ,QUARTER_ID ,PERIOD_ID 
FROM (
	SELECT orderdetail.ITEM_ID ITEM_ID
		, gmicuom.i2uom_cv(orderdetail.ITEM_ID,0,orderdetail.ORDER_UM1,orderdetail.ORDER_QTY1, itemmaster.ITEM_UM) ORDER_QUANTITY
		, orderdetail.FROM_WHSE WAREHOUSE_SHIPPED_FROM
		, DECODE(orderdetail.BASE_CURRENCY,orderdetail.BILLING_CURRENCY, orderdetail.EXTENDED_PRICE
			, Decode(orderdetail.mul_div_sign,0,orderdetail.EXTENDED_PRICE*orderdetail.EXCHANGE_RATE, orderdetail.EXTENDED_PRICE/orderdetail.EXCHANGE_RATE)
			) EXTENDED_PRICE_BASE_CURRENCY
		, pmi_sales_pkg.pmisa_get_charge(orderdetail.order_id,orderdetail.line_id,orderdetail.extended_price
			, orderdetail.billing_currency,orderdetail.BASE_CURRENCY, orderdetail.EXCHANGE_RATE,orderdetail.mul_div_sign) CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY
			, salesorg.CO_CODE SALES_COMPANY, orderhdr.ORGN_CODE SALES_ORGANIZATION, glcldr.period_start_date PERIOD_START_DATE
			, ou.organization_id operating_unit_id, glcldr.year_id, glcldr.quarter_id, glcldr.period_id 
	FROM PMI_GL_TIME_V glcldr, GL_PLCY_MST glplcy, OP_ORDR_HDR orderhdr, OP_ORDR_DTL orderdetail, ic_item_mst_b itemmaster, IC_WHSE_MST shippingwarehouse, SY_ORGN_MST salesorg, HR_OPERATING_UNITS ou 
	WHERE orderhdr.order_id = orderdetail.order_id 
		AND orderhdr.orgn_code = salesorg.orgn_code 
		AND orderdetail.from_whse=shippingwarehouse.whse_code 
		AND glplcy.co_code = salesorg.co_code 
		AND glcldr.set_of_books_name=glplcy.set_of_books_name 
		AND trunc(orderdetail.ACTUAL_SHIPDATE) between glcldr.period_start_date and glcldr.period_end_date 
		AND orderdetail.LINE_STATUS>=20 
		AND ou.organization_id = glplcy.org_id 
		AND itemmaster.item_id = orderdetail.item_id 
		AND 'TRUE' = PMI_SECURITY_PKG.show_record(salesorg.orgn_code) 

	UNION ALL 

	SELECT itemmaster.ITEM_ID ITEM_ID, gmicuom.i2uom_cv(itemmaster.ITEM_ID, 0, orderdetail.ORDER_QUANTITY_UOM, orderdetail.ORDERED_QUANTITY, itemmaster.ITEM_UM) ORDER_QUANTITY
		, shippingwarehouse.whse_code WAREHOUSE_SHIPPED_FROM
		, DECODE(SOB.CURRENCY_CODE, orderhdr.TRANSACTIONAL_CURR_CODE, orderdetail.UNIT_LIST_PRICE * ORDERED_QUANTITY, orderdetail.UNIT_LIST_PRICE * NVL(orderhdr.CONVERSION_RATE, PMI_COMMON_PKG.PMICO_GET_MULCURR_AMT(orderhdr.TRANSACTIONAL_CURR_CODE, sob.CURRENCY_CODE,orderdetail.ACTUAL_SHIPMENT_DATE, 1)) * ORDERED_QUANTITY) EXTENDED_PRICE_BASE_CURRENCY, (orderdetail.UNIT_LIST_PRICE - orderdetail.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE) * orderdetail.ORDERED_QUANTITY CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY, NULL SALES_COMPANY, NULL SALES_ORGANIZATION, glcldr.period_start_date PERIOD_START_DATE, ou.organization_id OPERATING_UNIT_ID, glcldr.YEAR_ID, glcldr.QUARTER_ID, glcldr.PERIOD_ID 
	FROM oe_order_headers_all orderhdr, oe_order_lines_all orderdetail, oe_system_parameters_all params, mtl_system_items_b msi, ic_item_mst_b itemmaster, hr_operating_units ou, gl_sets_of_books sob, ic_whse_mst shippingwarehouse, PMI_GL_TIME_V glcldr 
	WHERE orderdetail.header_id = orderhdr.header_id 
		AND params.org_id = orderhdr.org_id 
		AND msi.organization_id = params.master_organization_id 
		AND msi.inventory_item_id = orderdetail.inventory_item_id 
		AND itemmaster.item_no(+) = msi.segment1 
		AND ou.organization_id = orderhdr.org_id AND ou.organization_id = orderdetail.org_id 
		AND sob.set_of_books_id = ou.set_of_books_id 
		AND shippingwarehouse.mtl_organization_id = orderdetail.ship_from_org_id 
		AND trunc(orderdetail.ACTUAL_SHIPMENT_DATE) between glcldr.period_start_date and glcldr.period_end_date 
		AND sob.period_set_name = glcldr.period_set_name 
		and SOB.NAME = glcldr.SET_OF_BOOKS_NAME 
		AND HR_SECURITY.SHOW_BIS_RECORD( orderhdr.org_id ) = 'TRUE' 
) 
GROUP BY ITEM_ID ,WAREHOUSE_SHIPPED_FROM ,SALES_COMPANY ,SALES_ORGANIZATION ,PERIOD_START_DATE ,OPERATING_UNIT_ID ,YEAR_ID ,QUARTER_ID ,PERIOD_ID with read only

		AND ou.organization_id = glplcy.org_id
		AND itemmaster.item_id = orderdetail.item_id
		AND 'TRUE' = PMI_SECURITY_PKG.show_record(salesorg.orgn_code)

		, (orderdetail.UNIT_LIST_PRICE - orderdetail.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE) * orderdetail.ORDERED_QUANTITY AS CHARGES_BASE_CURRENCY, NULL AS SALES_COMPANY
		, NULL AS SALES_ORGANIZATION, glcldr.period_start_date AS PERIOD_START_DATE, ou.organization_id AS OPERATING_UNIT_ID, glcldr.YEAR_ID, glcldr.QUARTER_ID
		, glcldr.PERIOD_ID
	FROM oe_order_headers_all orderhdr, oe_order_lines_all orderdetail, oe_system_parameters_all params, mtl_system_items_b msi, ic_item_mst_b itemmaster, hr_operating_units ou, gl_sets_of_books sob, ic_whse_mst shippingwarehouse, PMI_GL_TIME_V glcldr

		AND msi.organization_id = params.master_organization_id
		AND msi.inventory_item_id = orderdetail.inventory_item_id
		AND itemmaster.item_no(+) = msi.segment1
		AND ou.organization_id = orderhdr.org_id
		AND ou.organization_id = orderdetail.org_id
		AND sob.set_of_books_id = ou.set_of_books_id
		AND shippingwarehouse.mtl_organization_id = orderdetail.ship_from_org_id
		AND trunc(orderdetail.ACTUAL_SHIPMENT_DATE) BETWEEN glcldr.period_start_date AND glcldr.period_end_date
		AND sob.period_set_name = glcldr.period_set_name
		AND SOB.NAME = glcldr.SET_OF_BOOKS_NAME

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "RMAN"."V_001" ("DB_KEY", "DBINC_KEY", "FILE#", "BLOCK#", "BLOCKS", "CORRUPTION_CHANGE#", "CORRUPTION_TYPE") AS 
  select distinct
  db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks, corruption_change#,
  corruption_type from
  (select db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks,
          corruption_change#, copy_stamp stamp, corruption_type
   from tb_004 union
   select bs.db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks,
          corruption_change#, bs.stamp, corruption_type
   from tb_005 bc, tb_006 bs
   where bc.bs_key = bs.bs_key) outer
where not exists
  (select 1
   from tb_001
   where outer.db_key = db_key and
         outer.dbinc_key = dbinc_key and
         scanned = 'YES' and
         outer.file# = file# and
         outer.stamp < stamp
   union
   select 1
   from tb_002 bdf, tb_003 bs
   where bdf.bs_key = bs.bs_key and
         outer.db_key = bdf.db_key and
         outer.dbinc_key = bdf.dbinc_key and
         outer.file# = file# and
         outer.stamp < bs.stamp)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "RMAN"."V_001" (
	"DB_KEY", 
	"DBINC_KEY", 
	"FILE#", 
	"BLOCK#", 
	"BLOCKS", 
	"CORRUPTION_CHANGE#", 
	"CORRUPTION_TYPE"
)
AS
SELECT DISTINCT db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks
	, corruption_change#, corruption_type
FROM (
	SELECT db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks
		, corruption_change#, copy_stamp AS stamp, corruption_type
	FROM tb_004
	UNION
	SELECT bs.db_key, dbinc_key, file#, block#, blocks
		, corruption_change#, bs.stamp, corruption_type
	FROM tb_005 bc, tb_006 bs
	WHERE bc.bs_key = bs.bs_key
) outer
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
	SELECT 1
	FROM tb_001
	WHERE outer.db_key = db_key
		AND outer.dbinc_key = dbinc_key
		AND scanned = 'YES'
		AND outer.file# = file#
		AND outer.stamp < stamp
	UNION
	SELECT 1
	FROM tb_002 bdf, tb_003 bs
	WHERE bdf.bs_key = bs.bs_key
		AND outer.db_key = bdf.db_key
		AND outer.dbinc_key = bdf.dbinc_key
		AND outer.file# = file#
		AND outer.stamp < bs.stamp
)

	, wxbl, xzcs, xscs, dw AS dwid
	, pkg_unit.getDwmcById(dw) AS dwmc

	SELECT count(1) AS zs
		, count(CASE

		END) AS ybl

		END) AS wxbl

			WHEN s.a_ajfl = '10'
				AND nvl(l.blsj, SYSDATE) - l.lrsj > 1

			WHEN s.a_ajfl = '20'

				AND l.lrsj > to_date('20150713', 'yyyymmdd')
				AND l.tbbz != '3'
			THEN 1

		, substr(sys_dwdm, 0, 8) || '0000' AS dw

	GROUP BY substr(sys_dwdm, 0, 8) || '0000'

SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT '- Tablespace ->',
    t.tablespace_name ktablespace,
    '- Type->',
    SUBSTR(t.contents, 1, 1) tipo,
    '- Used(MB)->',
    TRUNC((d.tbs_size-NVL(s.free_space, 0))/1024/1024) ktbs_em_uso,
    '- ActualSize(MB)->',
    TRUNC(d.tbs_size/1024/1024) ktbs_size,
    '- MaxSize(MB)->',
    TRUNC(d.tbs_maxsize/1024/1024) ktbs_maxsize,
    '- FreeSpace(MB)->',
    TRUNC(NVL(s.free_space, 0)/1024/1024) kfree_space,
    '- Space->',
    TRUNC((d.tbs_maxsize - d.tbs_size + NVL(s.free_space, 0))/1024/1024) kspace,
    '- Perc->',
    DECODE(d.tbs_maxsize, 0, 0, TRUNC((d.tbs_size-NVL(s.free_space, 0))*100/d.tbs_maxsize)) kperc
  FROM
    (SELECT SUM(bytes) tbs_size,
      SUM(DECODE(SIGN(maxbytes - bytes), -1, bytes, maxbytes)) tbs_maxsize,
      tablespace_name TABLESPACE
    FROM
      (SELECT NVL(bytes, 0) bytes,
        NVL(maxbytes, 0) maxbytes,
        tablespace_name
      FROM dba_data_files
      UNION ALL
      SELECT NVL(bytes, 0) bytes,
        NVL(maxbytes, 0) maxbytes,
        tablespace_name
      FROM dba_temp_files
      )
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
    ) d,
    (SELECT SUM(bytes) free_space,
      tablespace_name TABLESPACE
    FROM dba_free_space
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
    ) s,
    dba_tablespaces t
  WHERE t.tablespace_name = d.tablespace(+)
  AND t.tablespace_name   = s.tablespace(+)
  ORDER BY 8
  )
WHERE kperc > 95
AND tipo   <>'T'
AND tipo   <>'U'

SELECT *
FROM (
	SELECT '- Tablespace ->', t.tablespace_name AS ktablespace, '- Type->'
		, SUBSTR(t.contents, 1, 1) AS tipo
		, '- Used(MB)->'
		, TRUNC((d.tbs_size - NVL(s.free_space, 0)) / 1024 / 1024) AS ktbs_em_uso
		, '- ActualSize(MB)->', TRUNC(d.tbs_size / 1024 / 1024) AS ktbs_size
		, '- MaxSize(MB)->', TRUNC(d.tbs_maxsize / 1024 / 1024) AS ktbs_maxsize
		, '- FreeSpace(MB)->'
		, TRUNC(NVL(s.free_space, 0) / 1024 / 1024) AS kfree_space
		, '- Space->'
		, TRUNC((d.tbs_maxsize - d.tbs_size + NVL(s.free_space, 0)) / 1024 / 1024) AS kspace
		, '- Perc->'
		, DECODE(d.tbs_maxsize, 0, 0, TRUNC((d.tbs_size - NVL(s.free_space, 0)) * 100 / d.tbs_maxsize)) AS kperc
	FROM (
		SELECT SUM(bytes) AS tbs_size
			, SUM(DECODE(SIGN(maxbytes - bytes), -1, bytes, maxbytes)) AS tbs_maxsize
			, tablespace_name AS TABLESPACE
		FROM (
			SELECT NVL(bytes, 0) AS bytes
				, NVL(maxbytes, 0) AS maxbytes, tablespace_name
			FROM dba_data_files
			UNION ALL
			SELECT NVL(bytes, 0) AS bytes
				, NVL(maxbytes, 0) AS maxbytes, tablespace_name
			FROM dba_temp_files
		)
		GROUP BY tablespace_name
	) d, (
		SELECT SUM(bytes) AS free_space, tablespace_name AS TABLESPACE
		FROM dba_free_space
		GROUP BY tablespace_name
	) s, dba_tablespaces t
	WHERE t.tablespace_name = d.tablespace(+)
		AND t.tablespace_name = s.tablespace(+)
	ORDER BY 8
)
WHERE kperc > 95
	AND tipo <> 'T'
	AND tipo <> 'U'

SELECT
    a.contract_header_id,
    a.contract_number,
    a.contract_name,
    b.field_value contract_amount,
    c.payment_rate,
    d.id customer_id,
    d.name customer_name,
    a.salesrep_id
FROM (
    tcc_cpr.tcc_cpr_contract_headers a
    LEFT JOIN tcc_cpr.virtual_value2004 b ON
        a.contract_header_id = b.contract_header_id
    AND
        b.template_id =
            CASE
                WHEN a.contract_category = 'SALES'         THEN 1
                WHEN a.contract_category = 'INTERNATIONAL' THEN 49
            END
    AND
        b.enabled_flag = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN tcc_cpr.tcc_cpr_payment c ON
        a.contract_header_id = c.contract_header_id
    AND
        c.payment_condition_code = 'ZTE_PAYMENT_YUFU'
    AND
        c.enabled_flag = 'Y'
)
    LEFT JOIN tcc_cust.tcc_cust_customer d ON (
            a.customer_id = d.id
        AND (
                d.enable_flag = 'Y'
            OR
                d.enable_flag = 'T'
        )
    )
WHERE
    a.enabled_flag = 'Y'

            custjoin.join_type (+) =?

            h.visit_id = ourjion.visit_id (+)
        AND
            ourjion.join_type (+) =?
        AND
            h.customer_id = cust.id (+)
        AND
            h.enable_flag =?
        AND
            custjoin.enable_flag (+) =?
        AND
            ourjion.enable_flag (+) =?
        AND
            h.parent_visit_id =:1
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tcc_cust.get_visit_cust_name(h.visit_id) AS cust_name,

        h.visit_code,
        h.visit_title,

        h.visit_state,

        h.approve_state,
        h.evamemo,
        h.approver_leader AS approveby,
        h.created_by
    FROM

        tcc_cust.tcc_cust_visit_join ourjion,

    WHERE
            h.visit_id = custjoin.visit_id (+)

            h.visit_id = ourjion.visit_id (+)
        AND
            ourjion.join_type (+) =?
        AND
            h.customer_id = cust.id (+)
        AND
            h.enable_flag =?
        AND
            custjoin.enable_flag (+) =?
        AND
            ourjion.enable_flag (+) =?

            person.id IN (

                    (

                            tcc_cust.tcc_cust_customer cust

                            AND (

					WHERE t.enable_flag = ?
						AND cust.enable_flag = ?
						AND (t.is_temp = ?

						AND cust.id = t.customer_id
						AND cust.id IN (
							SELECT DISTINCT ucoa.cust_org_id
							FROM tcc_fnd.tcc_fnd_userorg_cust_org_auth ucoa, tcc_fnd.tcc_fnd_emplyees eep
							WHERE ucoa.user_org_id = eep.dept_id

SELECT cust_name, visit_id, visit_code, visit_title, visit_start_date
	, visit_end_date, master_dept_id, area_id, creation_time, visit_mode
	, track_flag, customer_id, visit_state
	, tcc_cust.get_join_info(lasttab.visit_id, ?) AS person_name, level_
	, approve_state, evamemo, approveby
	, (
		SELECT e.nameno
		FROM tcc_fnd.tcc_fnd_emplyees e
		WHERE e.emplyee_id = lasttab.created_by
	) AS created_by, area_name, master_dept_name, resultcount, resultnums
FROM (
	SELECT result.*, TO_CHAR(result.visitstsrtdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS visit_start_date, ROWNUM AS resultnums
	FROM (
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			SELECT resulttable.*, viewtable.*, area.full_area_name AS area_name, d.full_name AS master_dept_name
			FROM resulttable, (
				SELECT COUNT(1) AS resultcount
				FROM resulttable
			) viewtable, tcc_cust.tcc_cust_area_info_v area, tcc_fnd.tcc_fnd_depts_v d
			WHERE resulttable.area_id = area.area_id(+)
				AND resulttable.master_dept_id = d.dept_id(+)
			ORDER BY resulttable.creation_time DESC, resulttable.visitstsrtdate
		)
	) result
) lasttab
WHERE resultnums > :3
	AND resultnums <= :4

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE cursor_insert_user (
	inarea IN number
)
AS
	CURSOR c_user IS
		SELECT *
		FROM TEST_USER T
		WHERE T.active = 1
			AND T.area = inarea;
BEGIN
	FOR data IN c_user
	LOOP
		INSERT INTO USER
			(id, name, username, passwd, age
			, sex, level, area, created_date, version)
		VALUES (SEQ_USER.NEXTVAL, data.name, data.username, data.passwd, data.age
			, data.sex, data.level, data.area, data.created_date, 1);
	END LOOP;
END;

  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.OID as nID,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTNO as sContractNo,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTNAME as sCONTRACTNAME,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.ENGDUTYDEP as nOfficeID,
  TCP_FND_DEPT.DEPT_NAME as sOfficeName,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nSaleDeptID as nSaleDeptID,
  TCP_FND_DEPT1.DEPT_NAME as sSaleDeptName,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nProdDeptID as nProdDeptID,
  TCP_FND_DEPT2.DEPT_NAME as sProdDeptName,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CUSTOMID as nCustomerID,
  TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER.Name as sCustomerName,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sServiceProviderID as sServiceProviderID,
  TCP_CUST_ENUM.DESC_ as sServiceProviderName,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.MASTERPRODUCT as nMainProductID,
  TCP_FND_PRODUCT.CN_NAME as sMainProductName,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTTYPE as sContractType,
  TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.MEANING as sContractTypeText,
  EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Contrctkind as sContractKind,
  TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.MEANING as sContractKindText,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sIsFirstChecked as sIsFirstChecked,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sIsLastChecked as sIsLastChecked,
  case when (select count(*) from EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT,EPM_TBL_SUBCONTRACT_DISPATCH where EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT.CONTRACTID=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Oid and EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT.OID=EPM_TBL_SUBCONTRACT_DISPATCH.ENGINEID) > 0 then '/' else '&' end as sIsOutSource,
  case when (select count(*) from TCP_EPM.EPM_TBL_RECONSIGN_RECONSIGN where TCP_EPM.EPM_TBL_RECONSIGN_RECONSIGN.CONTRACTID=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Oid) > 0 then '/' else '&' end as sIsReconsign,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.dGuarantee as dGuarantee,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.dCreatedTime as dCreatedTime,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nERPContractID as nERPContractID,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nState as nState,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DFIRSTCHECKTIME as DFIRSTCHECKTIME,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DLASTCHECKTIME as DLASTCHECKTIME,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DPLANFIRSTCHECKTIME as DPLANFIRSTCHECKTIME,
  TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DPLANLASTCHECKTIME as DPLANLASTCHECKTIME
    from
    ((((((((( TCP_EPM.Epm_Tbl_Contract left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT on TCP_FND_DEPT.Dept_Id=Epm_Tbl_Contract.Engdutydep )
    left join TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX on EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.NCONTRACTID=Epm_Tbl_Contract.Oid)
    left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT TCP_FND_DEPT1 on TCP_FND_DEPT1.Dept_Id=EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nSaleDeptID)
    left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT TCP_FND_DEPT2 on TCP_FND_DEPT2.Dept_Id=EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nProdDeptID)
    left join TCP_CUST.TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER on TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER.ID=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Customid)
    left join TCP_CUST.TCP_CUST_ENUM on TCP_CUST_ENUM.Codeid=EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sServiceProviderID)
    left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_PRODUCT on TCP_FND_PRODUCT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.MASTERPRODUCT)
    left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE on TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.LOOKUP_TYPE='CONTRACT_TYPE' and TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.LOOKUP_CODE=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTTYPE)
    left join TCP_FND.TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1 on TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.LOOKUP_TYPE='CONTRACT_CATE' and TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.LOOKUP_CODE=EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Contrctkind)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "TCP_EPM"."EPM_VW_CONTRACT" (
	"NID", 
	"SCONTRACTNO", 
	"SCONTRACTNAME", 
	"NOFFICEID", 
	"SOFFICENAME", 
	"NSALEDEPTID", 
	"SSALEDEPTNAME", 
	"NPRODDEPTID", 
	"SPRODDEPTNAME", 
	"NCUSTOMERID", 
	"SCUSTOMERNAME", 
	"SSERVICEPROVIDERID", 
	"SSERVICEPROVIDERNAME", 
	"NMAINPRODUCTID", 
	"SMAINPRODUCTNAME", 
	"SCONTRACTTYPE", 
	"SCONTRACTTYPETEXT", 
	"SCONTRACTKIND", 
	"SCONTRACTKINDTEXT", 
	"SISFIRSTCHECKED", 
	"SISLASTCHECKED", 
	"SISOUTSOURCE", 
	"SISRECONSIGN", 
	"DGUARANTEE", 
	"DCREATEDTIME", 
	"NERPCONTRACTID", 
	"NSTATE", 
	"DFIRSTCHECKTIME", 
	"DLASTCHECKTIME", 
	"DPLANFIRSTCHECKTIME", 
	"DPLANLASTCHECKTIME"
)
AS
SELECT EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.OID AS nID, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTNO AS sContractNo, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTNAME AS sCONTRACTNAME, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.ENGDUTYDEP AS nOfficeID, TCP_FND_DEPT.DEPT_NAME AS sOfficeName
	, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nSaleDeptID AS nSaleDeptID, TCP_FND_DEPT1.DEPT_NAME AS sSaleDeptName, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nProdDeptID AS nProdDeptID, TCP_FND_DEPT2.DEPT_NAME AS sProdDeptName, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CUSTOMID AS nCustomerID
	, TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER.Name AS sCustomerName, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sServiceProviderID AS sServiceProviderID, TCP_CUST_ENUM.DESC_ AS sServiceProviderName, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.MASTERPRODUCT AS nMainProductID, TCP_FND_PRODUCT.CN_NAME AS sMainProductName
	, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTTYPE AS sContractType, TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.MEANING AS sContractTypeText, EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Contrctkind AS sContractKind, TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.MEANING AS sContractKindText, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sIsFirstChecked AS sIsFirstChecked
	, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sIsLastChecked AS sIsLastChecked
	, CASE
		WHEN (
				SELECT count(*)
				FROM EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT, EPM_TBL_SUBCONTRACT_DISPATCH
				WHERE EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT.CONTRACTID = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Oid
					AND EPM_TBL_ENGINE_PROJECT.OID = EPM_TBL_SUBCONTRACT_DISPATCH.ENGINEID
			) > 0
		THEN '/'
		ELSE '&'
	END AS sIsOutSource
	, CASE
		WHEN (
				SELECT count(*)
				FROM TCP_EPM.EPM_TBL_RECONSIGN_RECONSIGN
				WHERE TCP_EPM.EPM_TBL_RECONSIGN_RECONSIGN.CONTRACTID = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Oid
			) > 0
		THEN '/'
		ELSE '&'
	END AS sIsReconsign, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.dGuarantee AS dGuarantee, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.dCreatedTime AS dCreatedTime, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nERPContractID AS nERPContractID, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nState AS nState
	, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DFIRSTCHECKTIME AS DFIRSTCHECKTIME, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DLASTCHECKTIME AS DLASTCHECKTIME, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DPLANFIRSTCHECKTIME AS DPLANFIRSTCHECKTIME, TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.DPLANLASTCHECKTIME AS DPLANLASTCHECKTIME
FROM TCP_EPM.Epm_Tbl_Contract
LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT ON TCP_FND_DEPT.Dept_Id = Epm_Tbl_Contract.Engdutydep 
LEFT JOIN TCP_EPM.EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX ON EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.NCONTRACTID = Epm_Tbl_Contract.Oid 
LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT TCP_FND_DEPT1 ON TCP_FND_DEPT1.Dept_Id = EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nSaleDeptID 
LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_DEPT TCP_FND_DEPT2 ON TCP_FND_DEPT2.Dept_Id = EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.nProdDeptID 
LEFT JOIN TCP_CUST.TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER ON TCP_CUST_CUSTOMER.ID = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Customid 
LEFT JOIN TCP_CUST.TCP_CUST_ENUM ON TCP_CUST_ENUM.Codeid = EPM_TB_CONTRACT_EX.sServiceProviderID 
LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_PRODUCT ON TCP_FND_PRODUCT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.MASTERPRODUCT 
LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE ON TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CONTRACT_TYPE'
	AND TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE.LOOKUP_CODE = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.CONTRACTTYPE 
	LEFT JOIN TCP_FND.TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1 ON TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CONTRACT_CATE'
	AND TCP_FND_LOOKUP_CODE1.LOOKUP_CODE = EPM_TBL_CONTRACT.Contrctkind

  select Mod.CONTRACT_HEADER_ID,'',Mod.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID,
Mod.PROD_ID , Mod.PROD_DES,Mod.MI, Mod.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID, Mod.DEV_ID,Mod.DEV_DES,
Mod.SITE_ID , Mod.SITE_QUANTITY, Mod.SITE_DES, Mod.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID,
Mod.MOD_ID, Mod.MOD_DES, Mod.module_quantity, I.CONTRACT_ITEM_ID, I.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
ITEM_ID, I.DESCRIPTION ITEM_DES,I.ATTRIBUTE1 ITEM_TYPE , I.item_quantity,

Mod.prod_manager, I.COST_PRICE04, I.CONFIRM_ITEM_PARAM, I.CONFIRM_FLAG04,
I.cost_price, I.COST_PRICE_PARAMETER,I.OLD_COST,I.LIST_PRICE,I.ITEM_CODE,
I.CONFIRM_COST_PRICE04,I.PROD_ATTRIBUTE_ID,I.ITEM_CHIP from ( SELECT p.CONTRACT_HEADER_ID,'',P.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID,
P.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID PROD_ID,P.DESCRIPTION PROD_DES,P.MI, D.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID,
D.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID DEV_ID,D.DESCRIPTION DEV_DES, S.SITE_ID, S.SITE_QUANTITY,
( S.SITE_ADDRESS||S.SECOND_LEVEL|| S.THIRD_LEVEL|| S.FOURTH_LEVEL) SITE_DES,
M.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID, M.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID MOD_ID , M.DESCRIPTION MOD_DES,
M.module_quantity, p.hard_param, p.soft_param, p.make_param,p.risk_param,
p.soft_cost_param, p.prod_manager FROM ( SELECT PROD.*,SYS_ITEM1.ATTRIBUTE2
MI,SYS_ITEM1.DESCRIPTION, SYS_ITEM1.ATTRIBUTE3 PROD_MANAGER , SYS_ITEM1.HARD_PARAM,
SYS_ITEM1.SOFT_PARAM,SYS_ITEM1.MAKE_PARAM,SYS_ITEM1.RISK_PARAM, SYS_ITEM1.SOFT_COST_PARAM

WHERE DEV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND SYS_ITEM2.ITEM_TYPE
= 'SB' AND DEV.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') D, ( SELECT SITE.* FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SITES
SITE WHERE SITE.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') S, ( SELECT MOD.*,SYS_ITEM3.DESCRIPTION
FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_MODULES MOD,TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS SYS_ITEM3
WHERE MOD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM3.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND SYS_ITEM3.ITEM_TYPE
= 'MK' AND MOD.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') M WHERE P.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID = D.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID
AND D.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID = S.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID AND S.SITE_ID = M.SITE_ID
) Mod LEFT JOIN ( ( SELECT ITEM.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID CONTRACT_MODULE_ID,
ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, ITEM.CONTRACT_ITEM_ID, SYS_ITEM.DESCRIPTION, SYS_ITEM.ATTRIBUTE1,
ITEM.ITEM_QUANTITY, SYS_ITEM.CATALOG_SOFTWARE_FLAG, P.COST_PRICE, P.COST_PRICE_PARAMETER,

P.OLD_COST,P.LIST_PRICE, SYS_ITEM.ITEM_CODE, P.CONFIRM_COST_PRICE04, SYS_ITEM.ITEM_ID
PROD_ATTRIBUTE_ID,SYS_ITEM.ITEM_CHIP FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_ITEMS ITEM, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS
SYS_ITEM, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_PRICE P where ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = P.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "TPC_CPR"."TPC_CPR_ITEM_PRICE_V" (
	"CONTRACT_HEADER_ID", 
	"CONTRACT_NUMBER", 
	"CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID", 
	"PROD_ID", 
	"PROD_DES", 
	"MI", 
	"CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID", 
	"DEV_ID", 
	"DEV_DES", 
	"SITE_ID", 
	"SITE_QUANTITY", 
	"SITE_DES", 
	"CONTRACT_MODULE_ID", 
	"MOD_ID", 
	"MOD_DES", 
	"MODULE_QUANTITY", 
	"CONTRACT_ITEM_ID", 
	"ITEM_ID", 
	"ITEM_DES", 
	"ITEM_TYPE", 
	"ITEM_QUANTITY", 
	"HARD_PARAM", 
	"SOFT_PARAM", 
	"MAKE_PARAM", 
	"RISK_PARAM", 
	"SOFT_COST_PARAM", 
	"PROD_MANAGER", 
	"COST_PRICE04", 
	"CONFIRM_ITEM_PARAM", 
	"CONFIRM_FLAG04", 
	"COST_PRICE", 
	"COST_PRICE_PARAMETER", 
	"OLD_COST", 
	"LIST_PRICE", 
	"ITEM_CODE", 
	"CONFIRM_COST_PRICE04", 
	"PROD_ATTRIBUTE_ID", 
	"ITEM_CHIP"
)
AS
SELECT Mod.CONTRACT_HEADER_ID, NULL, Mod.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID, Mod.PROD_ID, Mod.PROD_DES
	, Mod.MI, Mod.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID, Mod.DEV_ID, Mod.DEV_DES, Mod.SITE_ID
	, Mod.SITE_QUANTITY, Mod.SITE_DES, Mod.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID, Mod.MOD_ID, Mod.MOD_DES
	, Mod.module_quantity, I.CONTRACT_ITEM_ID, I.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, I.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_DES, I.ATTRIBUTE1 AS ITEM_TYPE
	, I.item_quantity, Mod.hard_param, Mod.soft_param, Mod.make_param, Mod.risk_param
	, Mod.soft_cost_param, Mod.prod_manager, I.COST_PRICE04, I.CONFIRM_ITEM_PARAM, I.CONFIRM_FLAG04
	, I.cost_price, I.COST_PRICE_PARAMETER, I.OLD_COST, I.LIST_PRICE, I.ITEM_CODE
	, I.CONFIRM_COST_PRICE04, I.PROD_ATTRIBUTE_ID, I.ITEM_CHIP
FROM (
	SELECT p.CONTRACT_HEADER_ID, NULL, P.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID, P.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS PROD_ID, P.DESCRIPTION AS PROD_DES
		, P.MI, D.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID, D.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS DEV_ID, D.DESCRIPTION AS DEV_DES, S.SITE_ID
		, S.SITE_QUANTITY, (S.SITE_ADDRESS || S.SECOND_LEVEL || S.THIRD_LEVEL || S.FOURTH_LEVEL) AS SITE_DES
		, M.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID, M.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS MOD_ID, M.DESCRIPTION AS MOD_DES, M.module_quantity, p.hard_param
		, p.soft_param, p.make_param, p.risk_param, p.soft_cost_param, p.prod_manager
	FROM (
		SELECT PROD.*, SYS_ITEM1.ATTRIBUTE2 AS MI, SYS_ITEM1.DESCRIPTION, SYS_ITEM1.ATTRIBUTE3 AS PROD_MANAGER, SYS_ITEM1.HARD_PARAM
			, SYS_ITEM1.SOFT_PARAM, SYS_ITEM1.MAKE_PARAM, SYS_ITEM1.RISK_PARAM, SYS_ITEM1.SOFT_COST_PARAM
		FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_PRODUCTS PROD, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS SYS_ITEM1
		WHERE PROD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM1.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
			AND SYS_ITEM1.ITEM_TYPE = 'CP'
			AND PROD.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
	) P, (
		SELECT DEV.*, SYS_ITEM2.DESCRIPTION
		FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_DEVICES DEV, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS SYS_ITEM2
		WHERE DEV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
			AND SYS_ITEM2.ITEM_TYPE = 'SB'
			AND DEV.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
	) D, (
		SELECT SITE.*
		FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SITES SITE
		WHERE SITE.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
	) S, (
		SELECT MOD.*, SYS_ITEM3.DESCRIPTION
		FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_MODULES MOD, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS SYS_ITEM3
		WHERE MOD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM3.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
			AND SYS_ITEM3.ITEM_TYPE = 'MK'
			AND MOD.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
	) M
	WHERE P.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID = D.CONTRACT_PRODUCT_ID
		AND D.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID = S.CONTRACT_DEVICE_ID
		AND S.SITE_ID = M.SITE_ID
) Mod
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT ITEM.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID AS CONTRACT_MODULE_ID, ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, ITEM.CONTRACT_ITEM_ID, SYS_ITEM.DESCRIPTION, SYS_ITEM.ATTRIBUTE1
			, ITEM.ITEM_QUANTITY, SYS_ITEM.CATALOG_SOFTWARE_FLAG, P.COST_PRICE, P.COST_PRICE_PARAMETER, P.CONFIRM_FLAG
			, P.COST_PRICE04, P.CONFIRM_ITEM_PARAM, P.CONFIRM_FLAG04, P.OLD_COST, P.LIST_PRICE
			, SYS_ITEM.ITEM_CODE, P.CONFIRM_COST_PRICE04, SYS_ITEM.ITEM_ID AS PROD_ATTRIBUTE_ID, SYS_ITEM.ITEM_CHIP
		FROM TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_ITEMS ITEM, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_SYSTEM_ITEMS SYS_ITEM, TPC_CPR.TPC_CPR_PRICE P
		WHERE ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = P.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
			AND ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = SYS_ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
			AND ITEM.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
	) I ON Mod.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID = I.CONTRACT_MODULE_ID
